budget_policy: Thresholds checked between requests; last request can exceed threshold. Aggregate working ceiling $5 incl. pilot and recovery overhead.
timing_limitation: First 50 completed Sonnet answers unpaced; remaining Sonnet, cheap_no_tools and first 21 cheap_search locally paced at 3.5s. Tool workers then shared 2.5s; cheap_search_read completed in sequential phase. Persistent Session introduced at cheap_search fresh42, then cheap_search and medium shared 1.5s. Final medium from fresh91 uses one worker at 3.5s. Wall time includes queue, tools and HTTP; excludes manual recovery pauses and archived attempts. Not a pure model latency benchmark.
transport_diagnostics: Exception classes only; no retries or request changes

phase_change_after_reconciliation_4.execution: One worker at a time, same shared 2.5s gate
phase_change_after_reconciliation_4.reason: Repeated transport errors during concurrent workers; observed ReadTimeout. Causality not proven.

next_phase.reason: Paid models have no platform-level request cap; upstream limits may vary. Prior Sonnet HTTP429 does not establish the limit of GPT-4o mini. Stop-on-error remains enabled.

persistent_transport_started.change: Single requests.Session per process, HTTPAdapter(max_retries=0), closed in finally

final_parallel_phase.transport: one persistent Session per worker; no retries
final_parallel_phase.reason: TLS handshake stage identified and repeated handshakes reduced. Independent paid model providers share one start limiter; BLOCKED remains global.

final_medium_phase.reason: HTTP429 on second call; ledger reconciled twice after all workers stopped. First billing check did not match; no generation until later checks converged.

pacing_interval_note: Multiple phases: see timing_limitation and phase records; runner default is 2.5s.
merge: Copied disjoint completed worker directories into traces after identical manifests, final audit and two matching billing checks; no existing trace overwritten.
